regions.name: Malapert Massif
regions.nasaListing: Artemis III candidate region, NASA release 22-089 (Aug 2022)

observationPoint.selectionRule: Observation point = of candidate points on a 2 km grid within 15 km of the gazetteer centre, the one where the Sun's centre is above the LOLA terrain horizon for the largest fraction of 2027 (hourly).

horizon.method: Maximum terrain elevation angle along great-circle rays (80 m–150 km), observer 2 m above surface, spherical Moon R=1737.4 km; DEM samples beyond the 80°S product edge ignored.

notes: Reference feature Mons Malapert: IAU-approved 2024, 67 km across, centred 85.98°S 1.67°W.

Observation point = of candidate points on a 2 km grid within 15 km of the gazetteer centre, the one where the Sun's centre is above the LOLA terrain horizon for the largest fraction of 2027 (hourly).

regions.name: Nobile Rim 1
regions.nasaListing: Artemis III candidate region, NASA release 22-089 (Aug 2022)

observationPoint.selectionRule: NASA has not published coordinates distinguishing 'Rim 1' from 'Rim 2'. Observation point = of 72 rim-crest points (highest point between 0.8 and 1.2 crater radii along radial profiles every 5°), the one with the largest fraction of 2027 hours with the Sun's centre above the LOLA terrain horizon. It is a representative rim location, not necessarily inside the Rim 1 region.

horizon.method: Maximum terrain elevation angle along great-circle rays (80 m–150 km), observer 2 m above surface, spherical Moon R=1737.4 km; DEM samples beyond the 80°S product edge ignored.

notes: Reference feature Nobile crater: 79.3 km diameter, centred 85.28°S 53.27°E.
